scope_statement: This is a narrow clarification inside the already-consumed IMPLEMENTATION repair round. It is not a new audit, not the implementation re-audit, not a new repair round, and not authorization to execute any experiment or to open the method-lock test payload.

responds_to.codex_pause_reason: R9 states 'Metric definitions are taken verbatim from SC-01', but SC-01 names three secondary metrics without fixing component-vs-vector aggregation, terminal-vs-path increment aggregation, or mean-vs-RMS angular aggregation.

predicate: A metric-aggregation clarification is lawful at this point if and only if all four hold: (P1) SC-01 genuinely leaves the aggregation undetermined and no canonical formula exists repo-wide, so a choice is unavoidable rather than elective; (P2) no value of any affected metric has been computed on any split, so the choice is blind; (P3) the clarification changes no threshold, no declared endpoint, no population, no split, no seed, and no inference procedure; and (P4) the clarification is CONSERVATIVE-DOMINANT, i.e. the resulting gate acceptance region is contained in the acceptance region of every admissible reading of SC-01's own words, so no discretionary choice by the implementer can manufacture a PASS. P1-P4 all hold under the construction specified below, therefore B, not A.
why_not_A: The gap is an aggregation of two secondary diagnostic quantities feeding G1's sensor sub-clause, not the declared primary method-lock endpoint (R4 trajectory-level attitude geodesic RMSE), which already has a producer and is already computed.
G1's sensor sub-clause is a bare strict inequality with no numeric threshold, so no aggregation choice can be steered toward a frozen number.

The conservative-dominant construction removes the implementer's discretion entirely: G1's sensor clause is required to hold under EVERY admissible reading. That is the logically weakest commitment consistent with SC-01 and is the only reading that does not require inventing a choice SC-01 never made. It therefore adds no endpoint; it declines to invent one.

R9 already authorized implementing these producers inside the consumed repair round. The defect is confined to one inaccurate word in Claude's own counterproposal ('verbatim'), which overstated SC-01. Correcting a Claude-owned counterproposal's premise is Claude-owned and is not an implementation edit.

Declaring BLOCKED_CONTRACT_GAP here would close the study for a defect that is fully repairable within the authority already granted, which is a disproportionate terminal outcome and not required by the fail-closed rule once P1-P4 are satisfied.
what_would_have_forced_A: If any admissible reading had been unconstrainable by conjunction (e.g. a numeric threshold whose meaning depends on the chosen scale), or if any value of these metrics already existed on any split, or if the clarification had required editing SC-00/SC-01 or any frozen value, the verdict would be A.

common_quantities.index: t = 1..T are the trajectory's gyro/magnetometer event times after reset_trajectory; dt_t = t_t - t_{t-1} with t_0 the reset time
common_quantities.omega_tilde_B_t: the body-frame corrected gyro rate the variant actually supplies to propagation at t, BEFORE subtracting b_hat_r (model.py SideStepRecord.gyro_corrected_B). For raw-mode variants this is the pass-through packet; identity mounting is the frozen pilot invariant.
common_quantities.omega_target_B_t: SC-00 residual-bias-retaining target C_BSg A_g^-1 (y_g,t^Sg - c_g^Sg), already realized as data.py OracleSidecar.gyro_target_B_rad_s. Diagnostic namespace only; never deployable.
common_quantities.e_t: omega_tilde_B_t - omega_target_B_t in R^3, unit rad/s
common_quantities.z_tilde_B_t: the variant's corrected magnetometer body vector (model.py SideStepRecord.mag_corrected_B)
common_quantities.z_target_B_t: SC-00 inverse compensation C_BSm A_m^-1 (y_m,t^Sm - b_m^Sm), already realized as data.py OracleSidecar.mag_target_B
common_quantities.theta_t: atan2(norm(cross(u,v)), dot(u,v)) in [0,pi] with u = z_tilde_B_t/||z_tilde_B_t||, v = z_target_B_t/||z_target_B_t||; if either norm < 1e-12 the trajectory metric is non-finite and the divergence rule applies
common_quantities.reference_choice_is_not_discretionary: The magnetometer reference is the SC-00 oracle-corrected vector, not the noise-free field C_BN(q_true) m_N. SC-00 defines the compensation target as the inverse-calibration of the SAME raw packet and its gyro counterpart explicitly retains the transformed noise; a noise-free reference would require denoising that SC-00 never asks for. This is fixed by contract text, not by customary naming.

reading_declared_equivalent_not_a_separa.reason: exactly canonical/sqrt(3); a strictly increasing positive rescaling, so every strict inequality, fractional reduction and CI sign is identical. Asserted by test, not gated separately.

metric_definitions.cumulative_series: S_t = sum_{u<=t} e_u * dt_u in R^3, unit rad

reading_excluded_by_contract_structure.formula: RMSE of per-step increment errors ||e_t * dt_t||
reading_excluded_by_contract_structure.reason: under the pilot's uniform dt this equals dt * M1 exactly, so SC-01's requirement that N2 strictly reduce BOTH the rate RMSE and the increment error would be logically vacuous. Excluded by the contract's own conjunction, not by convention.

metric_definitions.angle_form_is_not_discretionary: atan2(||u x v||, u.v) is required; arccos(clip(u.v)) is forbidden as the producer because it is numerically unstable near 0 and pi and is not exactly equal in floating point.

metric_definitions.formula: sqrt( (1/T) * sum_t ||b_hat_r,t - b_r,t_true||^2 ) using the posterior b_hat_r after the update at t
metric_definitions.note: diagnostic; SC-01 line 27 explicitly removes R4 gyro/bias metrics from the G1 sensor predicates. Single pinned definition is sufficient because no gate consumes it.

metric_definitions.formula: numpy.percentile(phi, 95, method='linear') over the SAME per-step geodesic error phi_t already used by attitude_geodesic_rmse_rad
metric_definitions.note: diagnostic; must reuse the existing geodesic error function so it cannot drift from the primary metric.

metric_definitions.formula: 1 if any estimate or any per-trajectory metric of that trajectory is non-finite, or if max_t phi_t > 1.0 rad (strict); else 0
metric_definitions.note: already fully frozen by SC-01 line 51; reproduced here only for completeness. No new threshold.

record_and_window_aggregation.population_requirement: each gate array must be non-empty and all-finite; an empty or non-finite population is a hard error, never a silent pass

conservative_dominant_rule.statement: G1's sensor sub-clause passes only if the strict reduction of N2 versus N0 holds under EVERY admissible reading: M1 canonical AND M1 axis-mean on R1, M2 path AND M2 terminal on R1, M3 mean AND M3 RMS on R2.
conservative_dominant_rule.justification: This is the intersection of the acceptance regions of the admissible readings, hence contained in each. No aggregation choice available to the implementer can create a PASS that another lawful reading of SC-01 would deny. It asserts SC-01 as written without choosing on SC-01's behalf.
conservative_dominant_rule.direction_of_effect: strictness-increasing only; it can never relax G1
conservative_dominant_rule.scope_limit: This is the ONLY gate-arithmetic touch authorized. G1's R4 primary sub-clause (5%, CI below zero, two-of-three) and G0, G2, G3, G4 are byte-unchanged.
conservative_dominant_rule.reporting_rule: The canonical record metric of each pair is the value reported in tables and narrative; the second reading is reported alongside it. Neither may be silently dropped.

mutations_that_must_go_red: replacing the gyro reference omega_target_B with omega_true_B, i.e. scoring a compensator that removes the residual bias as if it were correct (ties the metric to SC-00's residual-retention requirement)
replacing the magnetometer reference z_target_B with the noise-free C_BN(q_true) m_N
dropping any one conjunct from the G1 sensor sub-clause
swapping M2 path-RMS for terminal-only, or M3 mean for RMS, in the canonical record
replacing the atan2 angle by a formula that differs beyond 1e-12 on the fixture
changing the window from whole_trajectory or introducing any truncation
any empty or non-finite gate population must raise, not pass
positive_assertions_required: an analytic fixture with closed-form M1, M2 and M3 values matched to atol 1e-12
sqrt(3) * component-pooled M1 == canonical M1 to atol 1e-12 (the declared equivalence)
dt * M1 == per-step-increment RMSE to atol 1e-12 (proving the excluded reading is degenerate)
required_red_path.matrix_binding: every mutation above must appear in RED_PATH_MATRIX.json with the test that went red and the full-suite result before and after (R11)

The IMPLEMENTATION repair round is already consumed, so the study closes COMPLETE_BLOCKED with no advance to ORACLE_HEADROOM.
consequence.if_codex_finds_a_conflict: If Codex judges that any formula here cannot be implemented without changing a frozen value, it must stop and return BLOCKED_CONTRACT_GAP rather than adapt a frozen value. Silent adaptation is a terminal integrity failure.
consequence.ordering_constraint: The lock must be sealed before the experiment stage begins. Defining these metrics after test access would place their definition at the moment of test access and would invalidate G1 irrecoverably.
